user.title: Add a Kachel device
user.description: Address of the Kachel device (port 6053 unless changed).

encryption_key.title: Encryption key
encryption_key.description: {name} already has an encryption key. Enter it, or open the window to add a Home Assistant on the device's setup page and try again: the integration then sets a key of its own.

error.invalid_psk: The encryption key is not accepted.

abort.already_in_progress: This device is already being added.
abort.not_kachel_board: This device is not a Kachel device this integration takes.
abort.no_mac: The device did not say its MAC address.
abort.held_by_esphome: The ESPHome integration still has this device. Remove it there first: a device is in one integration only.
abort.set_key_failed: The device did not take the new encryption key. Open the adoption window on the device again and retry.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different device.
abort.invalid_psk: The encryption key is not accepted.

data.allow_service_calls: Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions

data_description.allow_service_calls: The device asks Home Assistant to run actions, for example for the calendar or the to-do list. Turn off if you do not trust the device.
data_description.bluetooth_scanning_mode: How the Bluetooth proxy listens. Automatic: passive, active only when a device needs it. Active asks devices for more (uses more power on them).

service_calls_not_allowed.title: {name} is not permitted to perform Home Assistant actions
service_calls_not_allowed.description:
The Kachel device {name} tried to perform a Home Assistant action, but this is turned off.

If you trust this device, allow it in the options of the Kachel integration.

action_call_timeout.message: The action {call_name} on {device_name} did not answer in time

not_connected.message: {device_name} is not connected, the action {call_name} cannot run

enqueue_mode_not_supported.message: The device cannot queue with mode {enqueue}

repeat_mode_not_supported.message: The device cannot repeat with mode {repeat_mode}
